title: Associate Builders v. Delhi Development Authority

content.caseIdentity: Associate Builders v. Delhi Development Authority, (2015) 3 SCC 49
content.facts: The Court examined the grounds on which an arbitral award could be set aside under Section 34.
questionsBeforeCourt: What constitutes conflict with public policy and what is the permissible scope of judicial interference?
content.ratioDecidendi: Public-policy review is structured by the statutory grounds and cannot become a merits appeal.
content.holding: The Court articulated the principal public-policy categories then applicable under Section 34.
content.relevance: Foundational authority on public policy review under Section 34, read subject to subsequent statutory and Supreme Court developments.
